summary: Barings Private Credit Corp filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 715,267.588 shares of common stock at ~$20.00/share (determined per Investment Company Act Section 23) for aggregate proceeds of ~$14.3 million, conducted under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. This is a routine continuous private offering for up to $4.5 billion; the filing also discloses a regular monthly distribution of $0.175/share and NAV per share of $20.06 as of April 30, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or corporate action is present.
